stem.text: Structural isomerism **and** stereoisomerism should be considered when answering this question.
A colourless liquid, $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\text{Cl}$, exists as a mixture of two optical isomers.
When heated with sodium hydroxide in ethanol, a mixture of **only two** alkenes is formed.
What could the colourless liquid be?
